claims.content: The C2 JU initiates a J7.1 Data Update Request message by setting the Action field to value 1 (ACT = 1) for a specific Track Number (TN), addressing it to a specific Addressee TN or the collective address.
Upon receipt of the J7.1 (ACT = 1) message, the JU(s) that have originated surveillance amplification data on the track respond with a J6.0 Amplification message containing all available data.

The JU controlling the TN responds by transmitting appropriate J10 Weapons Coordination and Management messages and J13 Platform and System Status messages (including J10.5 Controlling Unit Report and J10.2 Engagement Status).
All C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their status.

If an R² shift occurs during the execution of a Data Update Request (DUR) response where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R² shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.
When responding to a J7.1 (ACT = 1) request for a line or area, a JU with R² shall transmit the entire line or area, except that covariance data will not be included on ballistic missile tracks.
